acceptanceCriteria: A record claiming run+reviewed whose receipt does not resolve to a bound passing receipt is downgraded or refused with a named code; reviewer independence is checked or reported NOT_OBSERVED; pinned by tests.
body: Residual of V1-1868 (PR #1165, head 4c494e642, GH #1162). Trust levels are provider-reported: run+reviewed is accepted as declared, without re-verifying the run receipt digest against a bound receipt or the independence of reviewers.
title: docs corpus: verify test-knowledge trust (reviewer identity, run-receipt re-verification) instead of trusting provider-reported levels
